CustomField.description:
High - Accounts with high engagement ie. recurring meetings, Enterprise pricing, TMF funded agreement, Partner Advisory Group member, pilot participation, etc.
Medium - Accounts with high engagement only during specific milestones ie. app launch, renewals, end user surges/issues.
Low - Accounts with low engagement limited to agreement actions, transactional/straightforward pricing, no regularly scheduled meetings, or intensive collaboration among Login.gov internal teams
